verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere exposes a well-documented, OpenAI-compatible cloud API (base_url swap works with official OpenAI clients) plus extensive first-party SDK method documentation across Swift/Kotlin covering LLM, STT, TTS, VAD, VLM, and tool-calling surfaces, all clearly documented at docs.runanywhere.ai. Missing for 10: a formal machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s for openapi.json/swagger.json) and independent hands-on confirmation that the public API/CLI is stable and agent-driveable end to end (community evidence mainly discusses local model quality/bugs, not API integration).
